errors.text_span: Sie startet im Januar 2015 knapp unter 100
errors.evidence: The light green line (HVPI) starts exactly at the index value of 100 in January 2015, not below it. The legend also confirms this with '(Index, 2015 = 100)'.

The light green line ends around July 2022 at an index value of approximately 120. It does not extend to Autumn 2022, nor does it reach the value of 141.2. The description mistakes the end point of the light green line for the starting point of the dark green line.

errors.text_span: endet kurz nach Anfang 2025 bei knapp 149
errors.evidence: The bright green line (darker green) ends in January 2025 at an index value of approximately 150, not 'just under 149'.

errors.text_span: erreicht Mitte 2024 ihren Endwert von etwa 156
errors.evidence: The dark blue line does not end in mid-2024. It continues to rise until January 2025, where it reaches its final value of approximately 156. The value in mid-2024 is lower, around 155.
